title: Sheep Farm Tycoon
description: Raise fluffy sheep across sunlit green pastures—shear wool, craft cozy textiles, expand barns, and build a thriving countryside ranch.
controls: Tap pastures and workshops to breed sheep, shear wool, upgrade production lines, and sell goods for coins.

zh-CN.title: 小羊农场经营
zh-CN.description: 治愈系放置牧场小羊农场经营：在青青草原养满圆滚滚的小绵羊，剪羊毛加工纺织品卖大钱，扩建你的梦幻田园牧场！
zh-CN.controls: 点击升级牧场与加工坊、饲养更多小羊剪毛售卖，不断扩建繁华的田园农场。
